legend: You are given an expression of the form $A$+$B$, $A$-$B$, $A$*$B$ or $A$/$B$ written without spaces. Print its value. For division, print only the integer part of the result.
input: One line with the expression: an integer $A$, a sign $S$ (one of +, -, *, /) and an integer $B$, with no spaces between them ($1 \le A, B \le 10^4$).
output: Print the value of the expression.
